native_result.query: Between 3400 BCE to 3000 BCE, how does the number of monuments and axes changes with elements of symbolic capital?
native_result.HypoA: Between 3400 BCE to 3000 BCE, the number of monuments and axes increases along with symbolic capital
native_result.HypoB: Between 3400 and 3000 BCE the number of monuments (MonumentCount/ZMonument) and of axes & celts (AxesCelts/ZBeil) is not positively driven by contemporary symbolic capital. The two targets move together as one peak in the 3200-3100 BCE bins (r=+0.87, exact permutation p=0.074) and their strongest companion is Depot/hoards, i.e. economic capital (r=+0.85 monuments, +0.93 axes/celts). Symbolic-capital elements add nothing contemporaneously: Daggers (ZDolch) are constant (Z=-0.58) and Hatchets&Swords (ZAxtSchwert) vary by 0.01 Z, so both carry no in-window signal, and House Size (Zhausgr) declines from its EN/MN maximum (+2.05 at 3400 BCE) to ~0, giving weak negative level associations (MonumentCount r=-0.35, p=0.60; AxesCelts r=-0.17, p=0.74; composite index identical to House Size, r=1.000) that reverse for Axes/Celts in the changes view (r=+0.50) and flip sign when the 3400 BCE EN/MN boundary bin is dropped (to +0.27 and +0.37). Pollen openness (Belau_PC1) is essentially unrelated to the targets (r=-0.02 and -0.22) but tracks House Size (r=+0.63), and House Size also tracks observation effort (r=+0.93 with kde_all_mean), so covariation involving House Size is demographic/sampling rather than symbolic. Hypothesis: in 3400-3000 BCE monuments and axes/celts are governed by depositional/economic activity and population dynamics, while house-size symbolic capital acts as a lagged precursor (~200 years) visible only in the wider 3800-2800 BCE context (r=+0.68 monuments, +0.56 axes/celts at +2 bins) - all statements conditional on N=5 one-century bins, for which no association is statistically decisive.
native_result.WorkflowB: Read-only inspection -> anchor grid extraction (100-yr bins, 5 anchors 3400-3000 BCE, CE=-BCE, calBP=1950-BCE, time_series authoritative) -> verified capital.csv == time_series_data.csv on all 12 paired Z columns (max|diff| 0.0) and Belau_PC1_inter == pollen_inter in-window -> per-target x per-predictor Pearson and tie-corrected Spearman with exhaustive 5! label-permutation two-sided p, leave-one-anchor-out ranges and interval sign agreement, for levels and for 100-yr changes separately -> composite symbolic-capital index from within-window z-scores (flat elements contribute 0) with dominance explicitly reported -> covariate checks: Belau openness (raw, 100-yr smoothed, recomputed 100-yr growth) and observation effort (kde_all_mean, g_all_mean) with partial correlations -> EN/MN 3400 BCE boundary sensitivity -> extended 3800-2800 BCE (11 anchors) cross-correlation at lags -2..+2 bins used only as labelled context.
